tokens.TITLE: Hello world
tokens.SUBTITLE: A one-page starter: markup, a stylesheet, and the smallest possible script. The demo assembled it from your two clicks.
tokens.RUNTIME: The preview is served as static files from the guest hosting site. Choosing Node.js adds server.js to the release so you can run the same page yourself; the preview itself never executes it.
tokens.ABOUT_BODY: One HTML page, one stylesheet, one script. That is the whole hello-world starter.
tokens.ABOUT_HOW: Assembled from two clicks in the guest demo: the stack, then the accent colour. Nothing here was typed.
